Bucket existence is therefore unknown from this evidence, and an unset variable is not evidence that no suitable bucket exists. Resolving the approved existing resource, and provisioning one only where none exists, both belong to ODP-STAGING-FOUNDATION-IAC-REMEDIATION-001.

read_only_attestation: Every command in receipts/ is a read: `gh api` GET and `gcloud --quiet describe/list`. No create, update, delete, set-iam-policy, enable-service or storage-write command was issued in the original collection run, in this reclassification, or in the remediation-table follow_up_readback_validation run, which re-executed only the table's own read-only `gh api` GETs and retained only their exit codes. Secret Manager probes read resource metadata only (`secrets describe`); no `versions access` was run and no secret payload, token or credential appears in any receipt or in this document. The only masked readback is ODP_RELEASE_LEASE_PUBLIC_KEY, withheld by length for conservatism.
